text:
Maria Chen: PTAL — addressed the review comments from yesterday. Renamed the test file (test_bulk_alloc -> test_bulk_allocator), removed stray debug prints, bumped fixture timeout to 30s. Split into 2 commits: refactor + changelog. Ran local smoke and unit. CI showed one flaky unrelated test. Can we get quick eyes? @Alex Park @Priya Nair

Alex Park: Looking now. quick q — why the timeout bump? was there an external dependency?

Maria Chen: The test was occasionally timing out on CI when the node is under load. 25s -> 30s keeps it stable. I added a comment in the test explaining the rationale and added a tiny retry wrapper.

Priya Nair: If CI passes can we merge and schedule canary tonight?

Maria Chen: Yes — I can queue canary after merge. I'd prefer to squash the two commits (refactor + changelog) into one when merging to keep history tidy. Thoughts?

Jamal Ortiz: Squash is fine. Any DB migration risk?

Maria Chen: No DB changes. Only test rename and changelog text. No runtime impact.

ci-bot: CI status — unit-tests: passed, integration-tests: flaky (1 failure: tests/retry/test_retries.py::test_retry_on_timeout), lint: passed — https://ci.example.com/build/1234

Alex Park: LGTM from me once CI is green. One nit: the header in the renamed test still references the old filename in a comment.

Maria Chen: Good catch — fixed and pushed. PTAL again.

Priya Nair: Quick ask — can you add a changelog bullet under 'unreleased' and reference the PR number?

Maria Chen: Added changelog under docs/changes/2026-03-17-unreleased.md with PR link. Also ran `make smoke` locally and `./scripts/run-e2e --quick` (both passed). Pushed.

Alex Park: :+1: approved.

Jamal Ortiz: Approved. schedule canary after 18:00 PT?

Maria Chen: Yep. I'll merge at 17:50 PT and kick canary at 18:05 PT. Re-requesting PTAL @Alex Park @Priya Nair — final check before I merge.

Alex Park: Eyes done, all good.

Priya Nair: All set from my side. :shipit:

release-bot: Merged PR #789 into main via squash. Canary scheduled at 2026-03-17T18:05:00-07:00

ci-bot: Canary smoke run started. status: running — https://ci.example.com/canary/456

Maria Chen: Thanks all.
